motion.reducedMotion: all durations resolve to 0ms; springs, scale and the fade-up are off; content appears in place and sheets cross-fade over motion.fast

elevation.raised: none: separation is a 1px hairline (rule.200), whitespace or the sand surface; never a shadow, an outline or an offset edge

_rules: Espresso editorial, service edition (2026-11-16, supersedes Signal). A service app first: the ask box leads. Cream paper, espresso text, forest green for action, brass for small highlights, sand for surfaces, thin rules and space.

Colour is evidence or brand. Forest green (brand.green, 8.9:1 with cream) is every primary action, selected tab, active state, link and focus ring, with cream text on it. Brass (brand.brass, 3.5:1 on paper) is for small non-text highlights only: a selected ring, a short line, a badge fill under dark text. It is never text on cream.
No pink, no gradients, no outlines around cards, no drop shadows, no offset edges. Separation is a 1px rule.200 hairline, whitespace or the sand surface (sunk).
ink.400 is 4.0:1 on paper: icons, rules and disabled states only, never text. Text uses ink.900 or ink.600.
The four truth colours are reserved and never used for buttons, charts or accents.
Confirmed is blue and Recent plum so no truth label reads as the action green.
A filled badge means a human verified it. A dashed outline means the web did.
Corners: photos square or radius.card (4); buttons radius.control (8), never pills; sheets radius.sheet (16).
The headline on a result screen is the value, not a sentence.
No dark mode in V1. If added, a separate contrast-audited set, never the light palette at low opacity.
A circle means a person: you, or someone nearby. It is never decoration and never a count the server did not send.
Field and control borders use rule.control (3:1 or better against card and paper, WCAG 1.4.11).

Display type is Newsreader (type.family.display), regular to medium weight, sentence case, slightly negative tracking at display sizes only. Body, labels and buttons stay the system face so Dynamic Type works unchanged. Photographs are rare: one on Welcome, small thumbnails in the service grid, none on results or empty states.
